postings.title: AML/CTF Compliance Officer
postings.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. 

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.



What you'll be doing

As our AML/CTF Compliance Officer, you'll support collaborations across teams to guide the safe innovation and introduction of new products while upholding regulatory integrity. 

Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - Identify and assess risks – Detect money laundering and terrorist financing risks, highlight weaknesses, and issue recommendations, taking a leading role in assessing risks specific to card issuing networks, investment platforms, and digital assets.

 - Product compliance – Partner closely with the Product team to support new launches and ensure continuous AML/CTF compliance of existing features.

 - Provide second-line oversight – Oversee first-line transaction monitoring and name screening operations, acting as the ultimate escalation point and conducting deep-dive investigations into high-risk customer relationships.

 - Report suspicious activities – Review suspicious activity and transaction reports to submit to competent authorities.

 - Ensure regulatory compliance – Collaborate with first-line teams to ensure Customer Due Diligence requirements comply with Luxembourg’s legal and regulatory framework.

 - Develop and refine policies – Assist in drafting and reviewing AML/CTF policies, procedures, and guidelines across all product lines.

 - Enhance training and awareness – Contribute to AML/CTF training programs to educate the organization on unique ML/TF risks.



Who we're looking for

This role needs someone proactive and analytical, capable of solving complex compliance challenges and balancing rapid innovation with prudent risk management.

 - AML/CTF expertise – 3+ years in AML/CTF Compliance, ideally in a Fintech, with specialised knowledge of ML/TF risks in payments, trading platforms, digital assets, and card networks.

 - Regulatory knowledge – Strong understanding of Luxembourg and EU AML/CTF regulations regarding Customer Due Diligence.

 - QA & monitoring – Hands-on experience conducting compliance quality assurance and monitoring activities.

 - Task management – Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, managing multiple high-priority tasks with high accuracy under tight deadlines.

 - Problem-solving and communication – Skilled at engaging with stakeholders across various business units to navigate AML/CTF compliance challenges.

 - Mindset & soft skills – Curious and communicative, with a strong understanding of risk assessment methodologies.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

As our Analytics Engineer, you'll be the analytical backbone of this ecosystem, combining deep technical craft with strong business partnership to build core data products. Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - Own critical products end-to-end - Manage the full lifecycle of warehouse data products and straightforward ingestions, ensuring lineage, PII handling, and auditability are foundational.

 - Enable the Data Mesh - Maintain shared dimensional models and central semantic metrics so definitions are registered once and consumed seamlessly across domains.

 - Automate regulatory reporting - Build and maintain the robust, highly auditable data models required to automate complex compliance reporting.

 - Partner on platform & agentic infrastructure - Guide shared warehouse infrastructure alongside the Data Platform team, and contribute the vital context that internal warehouse maintenance agents depend on.

 - Refuse to be a bottleneck - Intervene proactively when you are the sole holder of knowledge, sharing it through rigorous documentation and code review.



Who we're looking for

This role needs someone with a data product owner mindset who thinks beyond the pipeline to the end user, focusing on the decisions they need to make and how the data product unlocks value.

 - Technical mastery - Expert in SQL; proficient in Python for scripting, and pipeline work. You are a strong data modeler with experience designing scalable, future-proof models that serve multiple stakeholders and use cases.

 - Core tooling - Deep experience with dbt or other semantic modeling tools, familiarity with workflow orchestration, and you treat Git and CI/CD as standard working practice.

 - Exceptional communicator - Comfortable presenting methodology and findings to both technical and non-technical partners, including executive leadership. You have a proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity - You are a self-starter who takes ownership and drives projects forward with minimal oversight to define the workflows for a brand-new team.

 - AI-fluent & curious - You have working fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude, Cursor) and a grounded view of where it adds durable value.

 - Nice to haves - Prior experience as a Data Engineer, time spent in FinTech/highly regulated data environments, exposure to LLM tooling built on a data warehouse, or experience with dashboard tools like Looker, Hex, or Tableau.

postings.title: Chief Financial Officer - Satispay Bank
postings.additional_locations: London, UK; Barcelona, Spain; Amsterdam, Netherlands
postings.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.



What you'll be doing

As CFO for our Luxembourg-regulated entity, you will be primarily responsible for maintaining the financial integrity, regulatory compliance, and fiscal oversight of Satispay's European hub. Acting as a regulator-approved key executive, your role involves aligning ambitious group-wide corporate goals with the demands of banking compliance, managing the local balance sheet,  and safeguarding the entity's capital adequacy.
You will lead the entity's scalable Finance function, including statutory reporting, financial control, audit coordination, finance operations, and integration with the Group Finance organisation to support Satispay's growth and regulatory evolution.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - Reporting & Compliance: Take full accountability for the preparation and delivery of local statutory accounts, regulatory filings, and financial information required for Group consolidation, ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, compliance, and timeliness. Ensure adherence to Lux GAAP/IFRS, applicable regulatory requirements, and Group reporting policies.

 - Financial Strategy & Liquidity: Oversee the management of liquidity risks and the protection of client funds as per e-money statutes, while implementing effective yield-enhancement tactics for surplus liquidity. Lead treasury activities across the Luxembourg entity, including cash management, cash forecasting, and coordination with the Treasury team.

 - Risk Management: Track and uphold institutional capital benchmarks, establishing proactive detection mechanisms for market and liquidity exposures. Partner closely with the Chief Risk Officer and other control functions to ensure effective oversight of financial risks, including liquidity, capital, and balance sheet-related risks.

 - Stakeholder Representation: Act as Satispay's primary financial representative to regulatory bodies, tax offices, and external auditors, ensuring the successful execution of annual audits.

 - Financial Control & Performance Reporting: Oversee the Financial Control and Controlling functions, ensuring accurate month-end reporting, balance sheet integrity, and timely management information for local and Group stakeholders. Provide financial analysis and insights to support strategic decision-making and business performance monitoring.

 - Finance Operations: Ensure efficient and scalable Finance Operations processes, including reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and month-end close activities. Establish and maintain a strong financial control environment across all operational finance processes.

 - Intercompany Integration: Work closely with the Group CFO and Finance teams to ensure seamless integration of local financial activities, reporting, treasury, and planning processes within the Group Finance framework.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.



What we're looking for

We are seeking a proven leader with a distinguished track record of success in driving strategic initiatives and achieving significant business growth within relevant sectors.
You will lead by example, combining ambition with purpose, drive impactful results and cultivate ownership and continuous improvement in our dynamic environment.

 - Executive Experience: At least 8 years of leadership in financial roles at a primary EU financial hub or within Luxembourg-regulated payment institutions, EMIs, or banks.

 - Compliance & Regulatory Mastery: Deep knowledge of CRR/CRD directives, CSSF requirements, Luxembourgish accounting (Lux GAAP/IFRS), and safeguarding standards.

 - Regulatory Eligibility: Candidates must be qualified to meet the CSSF's "fit-and-proper" criteria necessary for official designation as an authorized director or manager

 - Technical Core Competencies: Proven track record across treasury management, financial control, statutory and regulatory reporting, audit management, capital and liquidity management, and finance operations within regulated financial services environments. Strong understanding of Group consolidation processes, financial governance frameworks, and interaction with auditors, regulators, and supervisory authorities

 - Language capabilities: Complete fluency in English

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.



Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact is met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

 - Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses.

 - Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant, and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding.

 - Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

 - Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.



CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

 - ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

 - 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

 - ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

 - 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.

 - 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

 

*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

postings.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

What you'll be doing

As our FinCrime Investigator, you'll move beyond standard forensic reconstruction to handle our most critical cases and influence our long-term strategy.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - High-Complexity Investigations – Leading end-to-end forensic investigations into the most sophisticated and multi-layered fraud types (e.g., organized scam networks, complex merchant ATO, and advanced AML/CTF syndicates).

 - Forensic Reconstruction & Intelligence – Gathering and analyzing data from complex internal systems and advanced OSINT sources to uncover hidden links and build evidence-based intelligence packages regarding new and emerging criminal schemes.

 - Mentorship & Quality Assurance – Acting as a key escalation point for our first line of defence, challenging assumptions, providing guidance on complex cases, and conducting quality reviews on investigation files and documentation.

 - Defensible Evidence Management – Applying meticulous attention to detail, ensuring all investigation steps, findings, and evidence are documented in an airtight, defensible manner ready for external auditors, law enforcement, or regulatory review.

 - Advanced Regulatory Reporting – Authoring and reviewing high-priority SAR/STR narratives for submission, ensuring the "Who, What, When, and Why" of a crime is indisputable under strict regulatory deadlines.

 - Strategic Control Optimization – Translating complex investigative findings into actionable intelligence, partnering with Product, Data, and Engineering teams to patch systemic vulnerabilities and design next-generation monitoring controls.

 - Focal Area Leadership – Owning a critical 'Focal Area' to proactively hunt for emerging, new-to-market typologies and presenting trend analysis to FinCrime leadership.



Who we're looking for

This role needs someone equipped with investigative tenacity, data literacy, and a relentless curiosity to uncover complex financial crime patterns.

 - Experience – 3+ years of demonstrable experience in end-to-end fraud, AML or corporate investigations. A background in Fintech is welcome, but we equally value experience in intelligence sectors, law enforcement, fast-paced banking, and complex corporate/advisory environments.

 - Investigative & OSINT Mastery – Expert understanding of fraud principles, complex criminal typologies, and forensic reconstruction. Proven expertise in applying OSINT techniques. Working knowledge of AML/CFT regulations and the Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) framework is highly preferred but not mandatory for candidates with exceptional fraud investigation backgrounds. Professional certifications (e.g., CFE, CAMS) are a strong plus.

 - Analytical Tenacity – Exceptional critical thinking skills with a natural refusal to take things at face value. Proficiency in navigating data analytics tools (like Looker, Splunk, HEX, or Redshift) and leveraging data to uncover the full scope of an issue.

 - Leadership & Mentorship – Proven capability to guide, coach, and elevate the technical and investigative skills of peers and junior team members.

 - Strategic Communication – Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex, disparate datasets into clear, actionable briefs for executive leadership and external stakeholders.

 - Proactive Intelligence – A restless investigative curiosity to hunt for invisible risk, challenge existing processes, and proactively close systemic control gaps.

 - Core Values – Unwavering resilience under pressure, a commitment to continuous learning, and the high-integrity judgment required to handle sensitive, high-risk financial crime incidents.

postings.title: Head of Brand
postings.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.



What you'll be doing 

As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint. 

Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - Creative Production - Owning the production of creative assets, ensuring every output meets a consistently high bar of quality, craft, and brand consistency.

 - Brand Activation - Driving both ATL (TV, radio, OOH, print) and BTL/untraditional activations, bringing the brand to life in bold and memorable ways.

 - Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance.

 - Brand Strategy & Insights - Shaping and safeguarding brand identity, and grounding decisions in research and listening, including surveys with both customers and non-customers.

 - Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output.

 - Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches.

 - Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.



Who we're looking for

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."

Questo ruolo fa parte del nostro impegno a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Per questo motivo, Satispay dedica questa specifica opportunità a persone con disabilità o appartenenti ad altre categorie protette, in conformità con la legge italiana sulla tutela dell’occupazione (L.68/99). Accogliamo candidature da persone con ogni tipo di percorso.

Non rientri tra i destinatari della L.68/99 ma vorresti comunque candidarti? Crediamo nel valore della diversità e del talento in tutte le sue forme! Se ti interessa questa posizione, ma non rientri tra le persone destinatarie della legge 68/99, clicca su questo link https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/satispay/db8bb67c-ab6c-4ef7-ab17-bd37fb7154f0?departmentId=2ca17579-a217-47be-bad2-8405d824ae83&utm_source=ourpeople per candidarti.



Chi siamo
Le banche tradizionali non ti hanno mai dato pieno controllo della tua vita finanziaria. Satispay esiste per cambiare le cose: per mettere il potere della finanza nelle mani delle persone.

Questo significa rendere i servizi finanziari semplici e accessibili per oltre 6,5M di utenti. Abbiamo iniziato dai pagamenti, poi i benefit, gli investimenti, le carte… e non abbiamo finito. Anzi, siamo solo all’inizio. Ogni volta seguiamo la stessa logica: trovare un problema reale, risolverlo come si deve, e passare al successivo. La destinazione? Costruire la piattaforma finanziaria più amata al mondo. Se ti prendi la responsabilità dei risultati e non solo dei compiti, se resti accanto a ciò di cui le persone hanno bisogno e non aspetti che siano gli altri a sistemare quello che non funziona — qui troverai persone che lavorano esattamente come te. E insieme costruirete qualcosa di cui essere fieri.

 

Cosa farai con noi

Come Inside Business Developer - Payments, avrai la responsabilità di espandere e massimizzare il valore dei nostri merchant attraverso la promozione telefonica di soluzioni di pagamento innovative.

Ecco cosa significa nella pratica:

 - Ampliare il network di Satispay - Acquisendo nuove attività commerciali che aderiscano al Network Satispay, con un focus primario sulla conversione di lead inbound.

 - Sviluppare il valore della Customer Base - Ingaggiando i merchant già attivi per promuovere l'adozione di nuove funzionalità e soluzioni Premium tramite attività di upsell.

 - Gestire trattative - Utilizzando capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione per ingaggiare e convertire efficacemente ogni cliente (inbound o outbound) in tempi brevi.

 - Gestire pipeline tramite CRM - Gestendo autonomamente il funnel di acquisizione e sviluppo su CRM HubSpot, rispettando gli standard di compliance richiesti.

 - Promuovere la soluzione Satispay - Spiegando i vantaggi, la semplicità e l'innovazione dei nostri servizi di pagamento ai potenziali merchant e ai partner esistenti.

 

Chi stiamo cercando
Per questo ruolo cerchiamo una persona fortemente motivata, con ottime capacità relazionali e di negoziazione, pronta a prendersi la responsabilità del raggiungimento dei target commerciali.

 - Intraprendenza - Hai una forte motivazione a metterti in gioco e a crescere professionalmente in un ambiente dinamico e ad alto ritmo.

 - Eccellenti doti relazionali - Sei capace di instaurare rapporti di fiducia immediati, positivi e professionali con interlocutori molto diversi tra loro.

 - Capacità persuasive e resilienza - Dimostri sicurezza nell'approccio telefonico, sai ascoltare attivamente e trasformare le obiezioni in opportunità di business.

 - Orientamento all’obiettivo - Ti trovi a tuo agio a lavorare con KPI chiari e definiti, ti motivano gli obiettivi e ami raggiungerli e superarli.

 - Passione per il Fintech e l'Innovazione - Hai un forte interesse per il mondo dei pagamenti digitali e per come la tecnologia possa semplificare il business dei nostri merchant.

Non preoccuparti se non ti riconosci in ogni singolo requisito. Crediamo nella forza di prospettive e talenti diversi. Il tuo punto di vista è importante mentre costruiamo qualcosa di speciale: se hai passione e pensi di poter fare la differenza, ti incoraggiamo a candidarti.

 

CareAbout: come supportiamo il tuo impatto
Andiamo veloci e la nostra evoluzione non si ferma mai. È un percorso entusiasmante, ma può essere sfidante. Per assicurarci che le nostre persone possano dare il meglio di sé, ci impegniamo a semplificare la loro vita, sia in ufficio che fuori. 

Ecco perché è nato CareAbout:

 - ❤️ Salute: assicurazione privata per te e la tua famiglia, supporto psicologico con Serenis, workshop sul benessere mentale.

 - 💰 Risorse finanziarie: piano di Stock Option, Buoni Pasto, supporto al trasferimento se cambi Paese.

 - ⚙️ Crescita e sviluppo: programmi di formazione professionale, mobilità interna, corsi di lingua con Preply.

 - 🌱 Flessibilità: ferie illimitate, policy di lavoro ibrido*, orari flessibili.

 - 👨‍👩‍👧 Famiglia: congedo parentale esteso, permessi extra per malattia dei figli.

*Prevediamo tre giorni a settimana in ufficio (martedì, giovedì + 1 altro giorno a tua scelta), con la possibilità di richiedere periodi extra di lavoro da remoto.

 

Stipendio: €25,000 - €32,000 lordi all'anno + variabile

Questi valori sono definiti sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere, in linea con i requisiti fondamentali della posizione. Tuttavia, crediamo che non si debba imporre un limite al talento. Il pacchetto retributivo finale sarà personalizzato in base alla tua esperienza e alle tue competenze uniche. Se ritieni che il tuo profilo vada oltre i requisiti standard, ti invitiamo a candidarti comunque: saremo felici di valutare insieme un'offerta che rifletta il tuo reale valore.

 

Equal-Opportunity Employer

In Satispay, siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità. Celebriamo la diversità e l'inclusione, accogliendo persone di ogni provenienza. Questa opportunità è aperta a tutti, indipendentemente, ad esempio, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale e origine nazionale. Unisciti a noi in un luogo di lavoro dove tutti si sentono parte!

 

Scopri di più su di noi

Vuoi sapere com’è davvero lavorare qui? I nostri valori e pilastri guidano il nostro lavoro ogni giorno: scoprili qui. https://www.satispay.com/it-it/lavorare-in-satispay/

postings.title: OSINT Investigator
postings.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.



What you'll be doing

As our OSINT Investigator, you'll move beyond standard forensic reconstruction to handle our most critical cases and influence our long-term strategy.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

 - High-Complexity Investigations – Leading end-to-end forensic investigations into the most sophisticated and multi-layered fraud types (e.g., organized scam networks, complex merchant ATO, and advanced AML/CTF syndicates).

 - Forensic Reconstruction & Intelligence – Gathering and analyzing data from complex internal systems and advanced OSINT sources to uncover hidden links and build evidence-based intelligence packages regarding new and emerging criminal schemes.

 - Mentorship & Quality Assurance – Acting as a key escalation point for our first line of defence, challenging assumptions, providing guidance on complex cases, and conducting quality reviews on investigation files and documentation.

 - Defensible Evidence Management – Applying meticulous attention to detail, ensuring all investigation steps, findings, and evidence are documented in an airtight, defensible manner ready for external auditors, law enforcement, or regulatory review.

 - Advanced Regulatory Reporting – Authoring and reviewing high-priority SAR/STR narratives for submission, ensuring the "Who, What, When, and Why" of a crime is indisputable under strict regulatory deadlines.

 - Strategic Control Optimization – Translating complex investigative findings into actionable intelligence, partnering with Product, Data, and Engineering teams to patch systemic vulnerabilities and design next-generation monitoring controls.

 - Focal Area Leadership – Owning a critical 'Focal Area' to proactively hunt for emerging, new-to-market typologies and presenting trend analysis to FinCrime leadership.



Who we're looking for

This role needs someone equipped with investigative tenacity, data literacy, and a restless curiosity to uncover complex financial crime patterns.

 - Experience – 3+ years of demonstrable experience in end-to-end fraud, AML or corporate investigations. A background in Fintech is welcome, but we equally value experience in intelligence sectors, law enforcement, fast-paced banking, and complex corporate/advisory environments.

 - Investigative & OSINT Mastery – Expert understanding of fraud principles, complex criminal typologies, and forensic reconstruction. Proven expertise in applying OSINT techniques. Working knowledge of AML/CFT regulations and the Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) framework is highly preferred but not mandatory for candidates with exceptional fraud investigation backgrounds. postings.title: Sales Development Representative - Welfare, Napoli
postings.description:
Chi siamo
Le banche tradizionali non ti hanno mai dato pieno controllo della tua vita finanziaria. Satispay esiste per cambiare le cose: per mettere il potere della finanza nelle mani delle persone.

Questo significa rendere i servizi finanziari semplici e accessibili per oltre 6,5M di utenti. Abbiamo iniziato dai pagamenti, poi i benefit, gli investimenti, le carte… e non abbiamo finito. Anzi, siamo solo all’inizio. Ogni volta seguiamo la stessa logica: trovare un problema reale, risolverlo come si deve, e passare al successivo. La destinazione? Costruire la piattaforma finanziaria più amata al mondo. Se ti prendi la responsabilità dei risultati e non solo dei compiti, se resti accanto a ciò di cui le persone hanno bisogno e non aspetti che siano gli altri a sistemare quello che non funziona — qui troverai persone che lavorano esattamente come te. E insieme costruirete qualcosa di cui essere fieri.



Cosa farai con noi
Come Sales Development Representative – Welfare, avrai la responsabilità di guidare lo sviluppo e la crescita della linea Welfare all’interno del segmento Large Enterprise (aziende fino a 350 dipendenti).

Ecco cosa significa nella pratica:

 - Generare lead qualificati - attraverso attività outbound ad alto volume, come cold calling ed email outreach.

 - Sviluppare nuove opportunità di business - entrando in contatto con HR, decision maker e stakeholder aziendali per presentare Satispay come soluzione welfare di riferimento.

 - Supportare il team Business Development - costruendo una pipeline solida di prospect mid-market ed enterprise.

 - Utilizzare strumenti CRM e di prospecting - come Salesforce, HubSpot, Sales Navigator e Lusha per monitorare attività, pipeline e performance commerciali.

 - Collaborare a stretto contatto con il team commerciale - per raggiungere e superare gli obiettivi di lead generation e contribuire alla crescita della business line Welfare.



Cosa stiamo cercando
Cerchiamo una persona orientata alla risoluzione dei problemi, che ami il lavoro di squadra e sappia portare risultati concreti. Se sei curioso/a e pronto/a ad assumerti responsabilità reali, potresti essere la persona giusta per noi! Ti riconosci in questa descrizione?

 - 1 anno di esperienza nelle vendite outbound – In particolare nel contatto e nel coinvolgimento di clienti Enterprise.

 - Forte attitudine commerciale e capacità di negoziazione – Con la capacità di comunicare con sicurezza e costruire relazioni con executive e decision maker di alto livello.

 - Buona conoscenza di CRM e strumenti outbound – Come Salesforce, HubSpot o Sales Navigator, per gestire pipeline commerciali complesse.

 - Ottima conoscenza dell’italiano e dell’inglese – Insieme a un approccio proattivo, orientato ai risultati, e alla capacità di lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e dinamico.

Non preoccuparti se non ti riconosci in ogni singolo requisito. Crediamo nella forza di prospettive e talenti diversi. Il tuo punto di vista è importante mentre costruiamo qualcosa di speciale: se hai passione e pensi di poter fare la differenza, ti incoraggiamo a candidarti.



CareAbout: come supportiamo il tuo impatto

Andiamo veloci e la nostra evoluzione non si ferma mai. È un percorso entusiasmante, ma può essere sfidante. Per assicurarci che le nostre persone possano dare il meglio di sé, ci impegniamo a semplificare la loro vita, sia in ufficio che fuori. 

Ecco perché è nato CareAbout:

 - ❤️ Salute: assicurazione privata per te e la tua famiglia, supporto psicologico con Serenis, workshop sul benessere mentale.

 - 💰 Risorse finanziarie: piano di Stock Option, Buoni Pasto, supporto al trasferimento se cambi Paese.

 - ⚙️ Crescita e sviluppo: programmi di formazione professionale, mobilità interna, corsi di lingua con Preply.

 - 🌱 Flessibilità: ferie illimitate, policy di lavoro ibrido*, orari flessibili.

 - 👨‍👩‍👧 Famiglia: congedo parentale esteso, permessi extra per malattia dei figli.

*Prevediamo tre giorni a settimana in ufficio (martedì, giovedì + 1 altro giorno a tua scelta), con la possibilità di richiedere periodi extra di lavoro da remoto.



Stipendio: €25,000 - €32,000 lordi all'anno + variabile

Questi valori sono definiti sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere, in linea con i requisiti fondamentali della posizione. Tuttavia, crediamo che non si debba imporre un limite al talento. Il pacchetto retributivo finale sarà personalizzato in base alla tua esperienza e alle tue competenze uniche. Se ritieni che il tuo profilo vada oltre i requisiti standard, ti invitiamo a candidarti comunque: saremo felici di valutare insieme un'offerta che rifletta il tuo reale valore.



Pari opportunità
In Satispay, siamo orgogliosi di offrire pari opportunità a chiunque. Valorizziamo la diversità e l'inclusione, accogliendo persone di ogni background. Questa posizione è aperta a tutti, indipendentemente - ad esempio - da etnia, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale o provenienza. Entra in un ambiente di lavoro dove chiunque possa sentirsi a casa!

 - Strategic Performance Reporting – Monitor rule efficacy and portfolio health, presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to evolve our risk appetite.

This role needs someone genuinely curious about how fraud works, and driven enough to stay one step ahead of it.

 - Regulatory Expertise - Hands-on knowledge and deep familiarity with compliance, legal, and regulatory matters.
